title: SUM skips BLANK values, and the sum of an int64 column is an int64

source.quote: Only the numbers in the column are counted. Blanks, logical values, and text are ignored.
source.supports: blanks do not take part in the sum

source.quote: corresponds to the following SUMX call
source.supports: SUM ( t[c] ) is SUMX ( t, t[c] ): a chain of additions

source.quote: The result is integer only when both operands are also integers.
source.supports: adding integers gives an integer, so a sum of an integer column is an integer

derivation: V[N] holds 5, BLANK, 0, -3, 5, BLANK, 2. Skipping the two BLANKs: 5 + 0 - 3 + 5 + 2 = 9. Integer + integer is an integer.
